claim: The COVID-19 vaccine causes infertility
expected_match: There is no evidence that COVID-19 vaccines cause infertility

claim: 5G networks spread coronavirus
expected_match: 5G networks do not spread the coronavirus

claim: Drinking bleach cures COVID-19
expected_match: Drinking bleach does not cure COVID-19 and is dangerous

claim: The Earth is flat
expected_match: Scientific evidence confirms the Earth is an oblate spheroid

claim: Climate change is primarily caused by human activities
expected_match: Climate change is driven by human activities including burning fossil fuels

claim: Vaccines contain microchips for tracking people
expected_match: COVID-19 vaccines do not contain microchips

claim: Hydroxychloroquine is a proven cure for COVID-19
expected_match: Hydroxychloroquine has not been proven to cure COVID-19

claim: Face masks are ineffective against respiratory viruses
expected_match: Face masks reduce the transmission of respiratory viruses

claim: The UK left the European Union on January 31, 2020
expected_match: The United Kingdom officially left the EU on January 31, 2020

claim: Wind turbines cause cancer
expected_match: There is no scientific evidence that wind turbines cause cancer

claim: The ozone layer is recovering due to the Montreal Protocol
expected_match: Scientific data shows ozone layer recovery since the Montreal Protocol

claim: Homeopathy has the same effectiveness as conventional medicine
expected_match: Scientific reviews find no evidence homeopathy is more effective than placebo

claim: GMO foods are unsafe for human consumption
expected_match: Scientific consensus holds that GMO foods are safe to eat

claim: The Great Wall of China is visible from space
expected_match: The Great Wall of China is not visible to the naked eye from space

claim: Global temperature has risen by 1.1°C since pre-industrial times
expected_match: Global average temperature has increased by approximately 1.1°C above pre-industrial levels

claim: Artificial sweeteners are worse for health than sugar
expected_match: Research shows artificial sweeteners are generally safe in moderate amounts

claim: Ukraine is the largest country entirely within Europe
expected_match: Ukraine is the largest country whose territory is entirely within Europe

claim: Eating carrots improves night vision significantly
expected_match: While carrots contain vitamin A, they do not significantly improve night vision

claim: The Amazon rainforest produces 20% of the world's oxygen
expected_match: The Amazon rainforest contributes roughly 6% of the world's oxygen, not 20%

claim: Poland joined NATO in 1999
expected_match: Poland became a member of NATO on March 12, 1999

claim: The Moon landing in 1969 was faked by NASA
expected_match: Multiple independent lines of evidence confirm the Apollo 11 Moon landing in 1969 was real

claim: Humans only use 10% of their brains
expected_match: Neuroimaging studies show humans use virtually all parts of the brain

claim: Napoleon Bonaparte was exceptionally short
expected_match: Napoleon was approximately 5'7", average height for his era

claim: Sugar causes hyperactivity in children
expected_match: Controlled studies have not found a link between sugar intake and hyperactivity in children

claim: Lightning never strikes the same place twice
expected_match: Lightning frequently strikes the same location multiple times

claim: The United States has 52 states
expected_match: The United States has 50 states

claim: Goldfish have a three-second memory
expected_match: Goldfish can remember things for months, not just seconds

claim: Immigrants increase crime rates in host countries
expected_match: Research consistently shows immigration does not increase crime rates

claim: Antibiotics are effective against viral infections
expected_match: Antibiotics only work against bacterial infections, not viruses

claim: Electric vehicles produce more lifetime emissions than gasoline cars
expected_match: Life cycle analyses show EVs produce fewer total emissions than gasoline vehicles

claim: Albert Einstein failed mathematics in school
expected_match: Einstein excelled at mathematics throughout his education

claim: Shaving makes hair grow back thicker
expected_match: Shaving does not change hair thickness, color, or rate of growth

claim: Vitamin C cures the common cold
expected_match: Studies show vitamin C does not prevent colds but may slightly reduce duration

claim: Bats are blind
expected_match: All bat species can see, and many have excellent vision

claim: The Sahara is the world's largest desert
expected_match: Antarctica is the largest desert by area, not the Sahara

claim: Reading in dim light damages your eyesight
expected_match: Reading in low light can cause eye strain but does not permanently damage vision

claim: There are more people alive today than have ever died
expected_match: Estimates suggest about 100 billion humans have lived, far more than the current population

claim: Sushi means raw fish in Japanese
expected_match: Sushi refers to vinegared rice, not raw fish

claim: Nuclear energy produces the most radioactive waste of any industry
expected_match: Nuclear energy produces relatively small volumes of waste compared to other energy sources

claim: Swallowed chewing gum takes seven years to digest
expected_match: Chewing gum passes through the digestive system in a few days, not seven years

claim: The unemployment rate in the EU reached 20% in 2024
expected_match: EU unemployment was around 6% in 2024, far below 20%

claim: Organic food is always more nutritious than conventional food
expected_match: Scientific reviews find little significant nutritional difference between organic and conventional food

claim: The Bermuda Triangle has a higher rate of ship disappearances than other ocean regions
expected_match: Statistical analysis shows the Bermuda Triangle does not have an unusually high rate of incidents

claim: Touching a baby bird will cause its mother to reject it
expected_match: Most birds have a limited sense of smell and will not abandon chicks due to human touch

claim: Cell phones cause brain cancer
expected_match: Major studies have not found conclusive evidence that cell phone use causes brain cancer

claim: Russia's GDP surpassed Germany's in 2024
expected_match: Germany's GDP remained significantly larger than Russia's in 2024

claim: Vikings wore horned helmets
expected_match: There is no historical evidence that Vikings wore horned helmets in battle

claim: Cracking your knuckles causes arthritis
expected_match: Studies have found no association between knuckle cracking and arthritis

claim: Renewable energy cannot provide baseload power
expected_match: Several countries now successfully use renewable energy for baseload power supply

claim: The COVID-19 virus was created in a laboratory
expected_match: The scientific consensus supports a natural origin for SARS-CoV-2, though investigations continue

claim: Dropping a penny from the Empire State Building can kill a person
expected_match: A penny dropped from the Empire State Building would not reach lethal velocity due to air resistance

claim: The tongue has separate taste zones for sweet, salty, sour, and bitter
expected_match: All taste receptors are distributed across the entire tongue, not in separate zones

claim: Water covers approximately 71% of Earth's surface
expected_match: About 71% of Earth's surface is covered by water

claim: The human body contains approximately 206 bones in adulthood
expected_match: Adults typically have 206 bones in their skeletal system

claim: India became the most populous country in 2023
expected_match: India surpassed China as the world's most populous country in 2023

claim: The speed of light is approximately 300,000 kilometers per second
expected_match: Light travels at approximately 299,792 km/s in a vacuum

claim: Antibiotics resistance is a growing global health threat
expected_match: The WHO identifies antimicrobial resistance as one of the top global health threats

claim: Finland consistently ranks among the happiest countries in the world
expected_match: Finland has been ranked the happiest country in the World Happiness Report for multiple consecutive years

claim: The Mariana Trench is the deepest point in the ocean
expected_match: The Mariana Trench, at about 11,034 meters, is the deepest known point in the ocean

claim: Carbon dioxide levels in the atmosphere have exceeded 420 ppm
expected_match: Atmospheric CO2 concentrations have surpassed 420 parts per million

claim: Japan has the world's oldest population by median age
expected_match: Japan has one of the highest median ages globally and the oldest population among major nations

claim: The European Union has 27 member states
expected_match: The EU currently consists of 27 member states after the UK's departure

claim: Plastic pollution has been found in the deepest ocean trenches
expected_match: Microplastics have been detected in the Mariana Trench and other deep ocean environments

claim: DNA was first identified by Friedrich Miescher in 1869
expected_match: Friedrich Miescher first isolated DNA (then called nuclein) in 1869

claim: South Korea has one of the lowest birth rates in the world
expected_match: South Korea's total fertility rate is among the lowest globally

claim: The International Space Station orbits Earth approximately every 90 minutes
expected_match: The ISS completes one orbit of Earth roughly every 90 minutes at an altitude of about 400 km

claim: The global literacy rate has been steadily increasing over the past century
expected_match: Global adult literacy has risen from about 42% in 1960 to over 86% today

claim: Mount Everest is the tallest mountain above sea level
expected_match: Mount Everest, at 8,849 meters, is the highest point above sea level

claim: The Amazon River is the largest river by water volume
expected_match: The Amazon River discharges more water than any other river in the world

claim: Honey never spoils if stored properly
expected_match: Archaeologists have found edible honey in ancient Egyptian tombs thousands of years old

claim: Switzerland has not been in a war since 1815
expected_match: Switzerland has maintained neutrality and not participated in armed conflict since 1815

claim: The transistor was invented at Bell Labs in 1947
expected_match: The first transistor was demonstrated at Bell Laboratories on December 23, 1947

claim: Global extreme poverty has declined significantly over the past 30 years
expected_match: The share of the world population living in extreme poverty fell from 36% in 1990 to under 10%

claim: Penicillin was discovered by Alexander Fleming in 1928
expected_match: Alexander Fleming discovered penicillin in 1928 at St. Mary's Hospital in London

claim: The Internet was originally developed as a U.S. military project
expected_match: The Internet originated from ARPANET, a U.S. Department of Defense research project

claim: Greenland is the world's largest island
expected_match: Greenland, at about 2.166 million km², is the world's largest island

claim: The human genome contains approximately 20,000 to 25,000 genes
expected_match: Current estimates place the number of protein-coding genes in the human genome at about 20,000 to 25,000

claim: Deforestation contributes significantly to greenhouse gas emissions
expected_match: Deforestation and land use changes account for about 10% of global greenhouse gas emissions

claim: The World Health Organization was established in 1948
expected_match: The WHO was founded on April 7, 1948, as a specialized agency of the United Nations

claim: Lithium is the lightest metal on the periodic table
expected_match: Lithium, with atomic number 3, is the lightest metal element

claim: Artificial intelligence will replace 50% of all jobs by 2040
expected_match: Predictions about AI job displacement vary widely and the exact percentage remains uncertain

claim: The long-term effects of microplastics on human health are severe
expected_match: Research on the health effects of microplastics in humans is still ongoing and inconclusive

claim: Dark matter makes up exactly 27% of the universe
expected_match: Estimates of dark matter's proportion of the universe vary between studies and measurement methods

claim: Remote work permanently improves employee productivity
expected_match: Studies on remote work productivity show mixed results depending on the type of work and methodology

claim: The Mediterranean diet reduces Alzheimer's risk by 40%
expected_match: Some studies suggest a link between the Mediterranean diet and reduced dementia risk, but exact figures vary

claim: China will become the world's largest economy by 2030
expected_match: Projections about when China's GDP will surpass the US vary significantly among economists

claim: Sleep deprivation has the same impairment as alcohol intoxication
expected_match: Some studies compare sleep deprivation effects to alcohol impairment, but the equivalence is debated

claim: Lab-grown meat will be cheaper than conventional meat by 2030
expected_match: Cost projections for cultivated meat vary widely and depend on technological breakthroughs

claim: Social media use directly causes depression in teenagers
expected_match: Research shows a correlation between social media use and teen mental health, but causation is debated

claim: Quantum computers will break all current encryption within 10 years
expected_match: Timelines for quantum computers breaking encryption vary widely among experts

claim: The global population will peak at 10.4 billion around 2086
expected_match: UN population projections have wide confidence intervals and the exact peak year remains uncertain

claim: Regular coffee consumption extends lifespan
expected_match: Observational studies suggest associations between coffee and longevity, but causal evidence is limited

claim: Ocean acidification will collapse global fisheries by 2050
expected_match: The extent of ocean acidification's impact on global fisheries is still being studied

claim: Intermittent fasting is more effective for weight loss than calorie restriction

claim: The lost city of Atlantis was located near Santorini
expected_match: The location of Atlantis, if it existed, remains a matter of speculation and debate

claim: Self-driving cars will eliminate traffic accidents entirely
expected_match: While autonomous vehicles may reduce accidents, experts disagree on whether they can eliminate all crashes

claim: Universal basic income reduces the incentive to work
expected_match: Studies on UBI pilot programs show mixed results regarding work incentives

claim: CRISPR gene editing will cure most genetic diseases within a decade
expected_match: CRISPR shows promise but timelines for widespread clinical application remain uncertain

claim: The Arctic could be ice-free in summer by 2035
expected_match: Predictions for an ice-free Arctic summer range from 2035 to 2060 depending on emissions scenarios

claim: Blockchain technology will replace traditional banking systems
expected_match: The extent to which blockchain will disrupt traditional banking remains a matter of debate
